title: The Fort Door Shut by Accident
youtube_title: The Fort Door Shut by Accident | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Staying beside someone is sometimes the whole gift.
summary: At a bedroom rug of cushions, puppets, and paper, Kei is just outside the fun, close to a blanket fort whose door flap had been pinned shut. Isla changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Kei has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Papa lets the children solve it.
